    • handleArrival

      public void handleArrival(Arrival a)
      Handles the arrival of a car at the intersection. Places the car in the appropriate queue based on its direction. Sets the car's waiting status if necessary.
      Overrides:
      handleArrival in class Intersection
      Parameters:
      a - The arrival event.

    • startPassingIntersection

      public void startPassingIntersection(long now, EventList eventList)
      Starts the process of passing cars through the intersection based on the traffic light states. Schedules departure events for cars passing through the intersection. Sets the intersection as busy while a car is passing through.
      Overrides:
      startPassingIntersection in class Intersection
      Parameters:
      now - The current time.
      eventList - The event list to schedule departure events.
